what: keyboard layout tables: key id -> jamo/literal for each supported layout
generator: tools/kbd2data.py (libhangul-derived layouts); tools/ist2data.py (sin3-p2 layouts); hand-authored for us/colemak/dvorak

source.name: libhangul 0.2.0 keyboard XML + pat.im/1136 날개셋 ist XML + this project's key-id convention
notices: data-orig/naraeseot/NOTICE (sha256 pins for the three ist files)
docs/SPEC-P2.md (normative extraction rules for the P2 layouts)
